## Purpose

What user problem does this solve? Link the issue if one exists.

## Changes

Describe the final change and any compatibility or migration impact.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Name any checks not run and why. For compatibility changes, record the T3 Code version or commit. For native checks, name the OS, architecture, and package tested.

## UI captures

Include screenshots or a recording for UI changes, with private data removed. Otherwise write "Not applicable".

## Contribution checks

- [ ] No personal database, pairing key, token, credential, or unredacted private data is included.
- [ ] User-visible changes and compatibility limits are documented where applicable.
- [ ] New dependencies, copied code, and artwork have compatible licenses and required attribution.
